title: Intrafoliaceous
summary: INTRAFOLIA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin intra and folium, a leaf.] In botany, growing on the inside of a leaf; as intrafoliaceous stipules.

inlines.v: INTRAFOLIA'CEOUS, adjective [Latin intra and folium, a leaf.] In botany, growing on the inside of a leaf; as intrafoliaceous stipules.
